name: google-workspace
description: Connect Google Workspace to MyCodex through a local MCP server for Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail, Calendar and more.

interface.shortDescription: Access Drive, Docs, Sheets, Gmail, Calendar and more through MCP.
interface.longDescription: Connect a Google account with local OAuth and give MyCodex a broad, pinned Google Workspace MCP toolset. Credentials stay on this machine and the integration supports Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail, Calendar, Chat, Contacts, Forms, Tasks, Apps Script and Search.
defaultPrompt: Find my latest project documents in Google Drive and summarize them.
Read the budget spreadsheet and identify the largest variances.
Draft a Google Doc from these notes, but show me the proposed structure first.

fields.description: Default Google account used by Workspace MCP tools.

fields.description: OAuth Desktop application credentials downloaded from Google Cloud.
